Name: SVE-Sophia's Anime Style Seasonal Various Portraits by Kove
Author: SHAMP233
Description:
[size=3]When the season changes , Sophia will put on new clothes and try a new hairstyle . There are 4 hairstyles she will try :

Spring - Vanilla
Summer - Braid
Fall - Long Straight
Winter - Ponytail

When I paint Sophia's straight pink hair , I find she looks similar to 02 , and she said she is a coser !
So I let her dress up as 02 on Spirit's Eve .

[b]
How to install:[/b]

 [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url]  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5969]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic for SVE[/url]  and  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1726]Pytk[/url] are needed .

What I've uploaded are just pictures and there is no "manifest.json" inside it , so it probably won't work if you simply put my mod into Mods folder .

you can find two folders in my mod :     [CP] Seasonal Cute Characters SVE    and     Stardew Valley Expanded

The first one goes into the same folder that you installed Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic for SVE.
The Second one goes into the folder that you installed Stardew Valley Expanded.[/size]

[size=3]Paste theminto the folders and click replace, and it's done .[/size] ([size=3] You will replace 17 pictures [/size])


[size=3]
[b]Thanks to my best friend for helping and encouraging me to finish this mod .
She's pretty and looks as same as Sophia that gives me inspiration to  make this mod .[/b][/size]



[size=3]More portraits will be added in the future.[/size]

[size=3]I've also made a mod for Olivia : [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9522?tab=description]SVE - Seasonal High-Res Anime Portraits for Olivia[/url][/size]
